functions.name: HistoryModal
params:
{
    visible,
    historyStack,
    selectedHistoryIndex,
    onClose,
    onRestore,
    onSelect,
}

callGraph.callee:
historyStack.map((item: any, index: number) => ({
            key: index,
            title: `本地记录`,
            description: `${item.description || ''} 索引：${index} ${item.elements ? '| 组件数量：' + item.elements.length : ''}`,
            isCurrent: index === historyStack.length - 1,
            isSelected: selectedHistoryIndex === index,
            type: item.type,
        })).reverse
